children: Advanced Micro Devices (AMD, Financials) might reach $1,000 over the next 18 months due to ever-accelerating demand for artificial intelligence computing, according to The Asian Investor.
A Seeking Alpha analyst raised AMD to Buy, citing strong data-center expansion, increased AI accelerator deliveries, and the chipmaker's recent announcement of the World Labs purchase.
AMD's data center business surged 50% year-over-year in the second quarter, further fueling the analyst's more positive prognosis.
The $1,000 objective is nearly 66% over AMD's latest share price of roughly $601.

The analyst points to new product launches and a surge in demand for AI processing capacity as drivers of additional development, saying AMD's growing accelerator business might justify a substantially higher value.
AMD shares had substantially revalued higher in 2026, before the optimistic call. That implies the corporation will increasingly require its operating performance to fuel future increases.
As the business seeks to grab a greater piece of the fast-growing AI compute pie, investors will be watching for data-center growth and the speed of AMD's AI accelerator deliveries.

title: AMD Just Got a $1,000 Price Target as AI Demand Accelerates
